about: R020 (lab PR 224): a web server's shell runs bash with stdin and stdout on a TCP socket it connected out (a reverse shell) — Critical, its kill held (action Log); python3 with the same, then bash on a pty whose parent's stdio is that socket (the pty-wrapped reverse shell) — both R020; a socket-activated bash (parent PID 1, an accepted socket) — nothing.
